d: Sonia Gandhi Book News : soniya gandhi ki kitab ko lekar bihar ki rajniti men ghamasan macha hai. kitab men nitish kumar ke jikr aur vipakshi dalon ko ekjut karne ki pahal ko lekar JDU ne aapatti jataee hai... sansad sanjay jha ne soniya gandhi ki tippani par saval uthate hue kaha ki nitish kumar ne INDIA gathbandhan ki ninv rakhne men aham bhumika nibhaee thi...vahin, RJD ne nitish kumar ki bhumika par saval uthae aur kaha ki sabhi dalon ko ekjut karne ki pahal lalu prasad ne ki thi... kangres ne soniya gandhi ka bachav kiya, jabki BJP ne kitab ko lekar nishana sadha... imarjensi aur…
